# SwagLabs Test Coverage Report

**Ground Truth:** `swaglab.md` (82 test cases across 9 modules)
**Generated Tests:** `gpt-5-mini/zero_shot_per_module/test-cases.json` (105 test cases across 9 modules)
**Generated by:** openai/gpt-5-mini | **Approach:** Zero-Shot Per Module | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

## Overall Findings

### Missing Coverage — Consolidated List

| # | Module | Missing Scenario | GT ID | Impact |
|---|--------|-----------------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Login | Case sensitivity check (capitalized username rejected) | SL-LOGIN-011 | Low |
| 2 | Product Inventory | Add 3 products — badge shows "3" | SL-INV-003 | Medium |
| 3 | Product Inventory | Sort Z-A | SL-INV-006 | Medium |

| 8 | Checkout - Overview | "SauceCard #31337" payment string | SL-CHK2-007 | Medium |
| 9 | Checkout - Overview | "Free Pony Express" shipping string | SL-CHK2-008 | Medium |

| 11 | Checkout - Confirmation | Success image (Pony Express/checkmark) | SL-CHK3-004 | Low |

### Generated Tests Strengths
The GPT-5-Mini Zero-Shot approach produces the most comprehensive test suite at 105 tests. It correctly identifies and tests all 5 valid user personas in Login, covers the full product detail error states (server 500, offline, invalid URL), and generates sophisticated reset state edge cases (race conditions, offline mode, large cart stress). The financial math in Overview is partially addressed but lacks the explicit 8% tax assertion and hardcoded payment/shipping strings.
